summary: This note is a clipped sidebar table of contents from the Nav2 (Navigation2) documentation, a ROS 2 navigation stack. It lists the site's sections: getting started, development guides, navigation concepts, a first-time robot setup guide, general and plugin tutorials, and a configuration guide. The list is cut off partway through the Behavior Tree XML action nodes, so the note does not contain the body text of any page.
one_line: Table-of-contents sidebar from the Nav2 ROS 2 navigation documentation, covering setup guides, tutorials, plugins and configuration.
key_facts: The Nav2 documentation sidebar has top-level sections including Getting Started, Development Guides, Navigation Concepts, First-Time Robot Setup Guide, Robots Using, General Tutorials, Plugin Tutorials and Configuration Guide.
The Getting Started section has subsections titled Installation, Running the Example and Navigating.

The Development Guides section includes Build and Install, Dev Containers and Getting Involved, and Build and Install has subsections for Released Distribution Binaries, Rolling Development Source and Docker Container Images.
The Dev Containers guide has subsections Creating Dev Containers and Using Dev Containers, and the Getting Involved section covers Process, Licensing and the Developer Certification of Origin (DCO).
The Navigation Concepts section covers Behavior Trees, Navigation Servers, State Estimation, Environmental Representation and a Nav2 Academic Overview.
The Navigation Servers concept lists Planners, Controllers, Behaviors, Smoothers, Robot Footprints and Waypoint Following.

The First-Time Robot Setup Guide includes tutorials on Setting Up Transformations, Setting Up The URDF, Setting Up Odometry, Setting Up Sensors, Setting Up the Robot's Footprint and Setting Up Navigation Plugins.
The Setting Up Odometry guide includes a Robot Localization Demo and a Gazebo odometry simulation section.

The General Tutorials section includes Navigating with a Physical Turtlebot 3, SLAM navigation, STVL external costmap plugin, GPS localization, Groot behavior tree interaction, VIO odometry with a ZED X Camera, and Dynamic Object Following.

Other general tutorials cover Keepout Zones, Speed Limits, the Rotation Shim Controller, adding a smoother to a behavior tree, Collision Monitor, adding a new Nav2 task server, filtering noise-induced obstacles, camera calibration, backtraces, profiling and Docker for development.
The Plugin Tutorials section includes guides for writing a new Costmap2D plugin, Planner plugin, Controller plugin, Behavior Tree plugin, Behavior plugin and Navigator plugin.
The Costmap2D plugin tutorial builds a GradientLayer plugin, and the planner plugin tutorial runs a StraightLine plugin.
The controller plugin tutorial runs a Pure Pursuit Controller plugin.
The Configuration Guide covers the Behavior-Tree Navigator, Behavior Tree XML Nodes and a list of Behavior Tree action plugins such as Wait, Spin, BackUp, FollowPath and NavigateToPose.
The note is truncated during the Behavior Tree XML action plugin list, at the CancelSpin entry.
